name: structural-scanner-crate
body: The `src/structlib` crate and its `structfrontend` binary: the single self-contained Rust artifact that walks a checkout, claims the structural files, and streams their `File`/`Struct`/`contains` records. It absorbs the existing `src/mdlib` Markdown frontend (`rust.mdfrontend`), keeping the `md` stream id for Markdown. No scan-time toolchain, no external runtime, no engine pin beyond its crates.
